label: Create Companies List

headings.className: section-header-label section-header-label--rule block! border-b pb-3 text-c-1 responses-title--tree mt-3 mb-0 block! leading-[1.45] font-medium

paragraphs: Create an immutable list of companies you already own (domain values from search results). Pass the returned id in exclude_lists on companies search — matched companies are not returned and not charged. Lists can't be modified: to grow your ledger, create a new list per batch and pass all ids; consolidate periodically. Domains are normalized on write; unparseable values are skipped and reported. Limits: 100,000 values per list; per search request: 100 lists, 500,000 values combined.
